name: Map 14-02-07.png
map:
This picture is UXDuck's flat map as it was shown, in Web Mercator (EPSG:3857), north up, looking straight down. In this 1024 × 640 picture, in pixels from its top left:
- (0, 0) is latitude -35.3600000, longitude 149.1600000
- (1024, 0) is latitude -35.3600000, longitude 149.1700000
- (0, 640) is latitude -35.3650000, longitude 149.1600000
- (1024, 640) is latitude -35.3650000, longitude 149.1700000
It shows from latitude -35.3650000 to -35.3600000 and from longitude 149.1600000 to 149.1700000. A pixel's longitude is linear in x between the left and right edges. Its latitude is linear in y in Web Mercator's y, ln(tan(45° + latitude / 2)), between the top and bottom edges, not in degrees.
note: Made a JPEG of the PNG. Scaled from the picture's 2400 × 1500 to 1024 × 640.
